title: Daily Temperatures / Next Greater Element
contract: For each temperature, return days until a strictly warmer day, or 0 if none follows.
brute: int[] out=new int[a.length];for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<a.length;j++){emit("Search for a warmer day","indices",new int[]{i,j},"temperatures",a);if(a[j]>a[i]){out[i]=j-i;break;}}return out;
optimal: int[] out=new int[a.length];Deque<Integer> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){while(!stack.isEmpty()&&a[i]>a[stack.peek()]){int j=stack.pop();out[j]=i-j;emit("Resolve an earlier colder day","day",j,"wait",out[j],"output",out);}stack.push(i);emit("Store an unresolved index","stack",stack);}return out;
reasoning: Search forward from every day until the first strictly greater temperature.
Keep unresolved indices in a stack whose temperatures are nonincreasing.
Each index is pushed and popped at most once, so the nested while loop is linear overall. Equal temperatures must not resolve each other.
